problem: Suppose that $|\,a\,|=6$, $|\,b\,|=2$ and that the angle between the vectors is $\theta =\frac{\pi }{3}.$ Find the vector projection of $a$ onto $b$ in terms of the vector $b.$
worked_solution:
First, we find the scalar projection as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{b}\,a & =|\,a\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =6\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{3}) \\  & =6\cdot \frac{1}{2} \\  & =3\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we find the unit vector that is parallel to $b:$

$$
u=\frac{b}{|\,b\,|}=\frac{b}{2}=\frac{1}{2}b
$$

Finally, we compute the vector projection as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & ={\text{comp}}_{b}\,a\cdot u \\  & =3\cdot \frac{1}{2}b \\  & =\frac{3}{2}b\end{aligned}
$$
